screen.rationale: Primary study of photocatalytic ester C-O cleavage in designed polyarylate/PU/PET. All degradation conditions with text-accessible endpoints use 365 nm irradiation (UV-only, out of scope under E3); the only visible-light run (450 nm LED, Figure 3 footnote c) has its values only in the Figure 3 graphic, and Table 1 (reaction acceleration) is an image with no text values. No in-scope endpoint is accessible as text or table values.
